author: FAANews
name: The FAA ✈️
text: Laser strikes against aircraft pose serious dangers to pilots, crew, and passengers. The FAA has a dedicated team that works with law enforcement to investigate these incidents and prosecute those responsible. Discover how the FAA’s Law Enforcement Assistance Program – LEAP – works with public safety groups on a variety of aviation-related cases and turns findings into safety action, prevention for future occurrences. https://bit.ly/47ZvPm9 #LoseTheLaser #FAAInAction
